title: Chapter 1464 - 9: Growing Further Apart (Part 3)
content:
Chapter 1464 - 9: Growing Further Apart (Part 3)

Chapter 1464 - 9: Growing Further Apart (Part 3)

A figure suddenly dashed out.

The aura was as powerful as that of Fantian Lord, Lord Haotian, and other Legendary Lords.

This suddenly appeared figure had clearly been lurking for some time, seizing the opportunity during the battle among Fantian Lord and the other four Lords, hoping to be the first to step onto the unified white jade steps and gain the advantage.

"Nine Dragons, come back to me!"

Lord Wan Xiang raised his hand, compressing layers of space-time, forcibly pulling back the figure that was about to step onto the unified white jade steps.

"Good technique."

The Lord of Nine Dragons turned back.

He had concealed his strength and aura, attempting to strike at the crucial moment, yet still failed.

"Nine Dragons, when did you pass the third billionth trial?"

Fantian Lord looked towards the Lord of Nine Dragons and asked.

"That's not something you need to know."

The Lord of Nine Dragons chuckled.

Then.

The battle continued to escalate, besides the Lord of Nine Dragons.

Two more Legendary Lords who had passed the third billionth trial appeared.

However, compared to the Galaxy Lord who appeared out of

nowhere, the Lord of Nine Dragons and the other two Legendary Lords were already renowned for a long time. Even if they hadn't erupted with power comparable to Haotian and Fantian, they had previously been close to that level.

Buzz, buzz, buzz- Seven or eight terrifying auras clashed in front of the unified white jade steps.

Finally-

"Hahahahaha."

The Sage exuded an overwhelming aura, forcibly breaking through the blockade of other Legendary Lords, ultimately stepping onto the unified white jade steps.

"Sage?"

Lord Haotian looked at the ancient figure standing on the unified white jade steps.

For the Sage, this ancient Legendary Lord, he actually held little regard. Born shortly after the opening of the endless dimension and surviving till now, could his exploration of the path of transcendence compare to his own?

However, through that recent battle.

Lord Haotian realized that the Sage's strength was no weaker than his

own.

Otherwise, it would have been impossible for him to forcibly ascend the unified white jade steps amidst the fierce battle of Legendary Lords at their level.

"We underestimated you."

Fantian Lord also looked at the Sage.

One by one, the Legendary Lords ceased their combat.

"Thank you for letting me win."

A smile appeared on the Sage's face.

In terms of raw strength, he was inferior to Fantian and Lord Haotian.

On this white jade step, all the Sage's accumulated potential was fully unleashed, causing his strength to surge dramatically, reaching the level of Fantian and Haotian.

In addition, with his long years of experience, he had created many Secret Techniques, which enabled him to reach the end of this struggle.

"Transcendence, I will ultimately transcend!"

Standing on the unified white jade steps, the Sage had boundless ambition, his gaze swept over Fantian Lord, Lord Haotian, Lord Wan Xiang, and other Legendary Lords: "I have already stepped over all the most powerful Legendary Lords. If I do not transcend, who can?!"

The Sage, lost in thought, looked at the Legendary Lords below, suddenly sensing something amiss.

Fantian Lord, Lord Haotian, Lord Wan Xiang... plus the three Lords who silently passed the third billionth trial, a total of seven Legendary Lords, all were below.

But where was the Galaxy Lord?

Regarding the battle where the Galaxy Lord broke through Lord Zhuo He, the Sage also witnessed.

Fully aware that he was no match for the Galaxy Lord, before the contention for the unified white jade steps, the Sage had been on guard, wary of the Galaxy Lord lurking in the shadows.

Yet from start to finish, the Galaxy Lord never appeared.

If, at the beginning, the Galaxy Lord was hiding for a sudden burst to

step onto the unified white jade steps, now that he himself had ascended the steps, why hadn't the Galaxy Lord made a move?

"Galaxy Lord?"

The Sage's gaze swept across each white jade step, ultimately finding nothing, failing to spot any trace of the Galaxy Lord.

Instinctively.

The Sage's gaze turned upwards to the top of the unified white jade

steps.

Endless steps of white jade extended seemingly towards the eternal

pinnacle.

At the edge of his sight, on steps unknown in number from the position where the Sage stood.

The Sage finally noticed a figure gradually ascending, its back towards

him.

Due to the vast distance, this figure appeared somewhat indistinct.

But the Sage instantly recognized this figure as the Galaxy Lord.

"What?!!"

The Sage's mind went blank, his heart quivering.
